## How it works

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.feature-grid__card}
### Scientific catalogs
Every point is backed by data pulled from NASA archives and international sky surveys.
:::

::: {.feature-grid__card}
### True positions in 3D space
Each object sits at its measured distance and position, so you can explore datasets in their simulated environment.
:::

::: {.feature-grid__card}
### Toggle live during a presentation
Turn any catalog on or off, adjust marker size and color, and blend multiple datasets live or add your own data to explore.
:::
